answer: Because the dawn decay is applied at each close, the pulse audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 36% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the delta fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 18 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
